beats: Hook: face to camera with an on-screen 'PART 5' label. 'I'm reacting to the funniest e-diary remarks, part 5. This time we start aggressively, with a remark one of you sent me.'

Remark 1 (screenshot overlay): after being warned to put away his phone during class, the student yelled. Creator voices him: 'Leave me alone, old lady, I'm playing Clash Royale.' Joke defending him: maybe his opponent played Mega Knight, she can't forbid everything, he'll lose trophies.

Remark 2 (overlay): during a test the student took out a pre-solved test and tried to hand it in as his own work. Joke: 'What did this guy come up with? He's out of the public eye for 3 days and he's already plotting a scam.'
Remark 3 (overlay): the student submitted a photo of a doctor's note, which turned out to be AI-generated. Joke: 'Honestly, it's not bad, it might even pass with some teachers… don't try it.'

Segue + Memo AI demo: 'If you're going to use AI anyway, better use it the right way, like Memo AI, the study app.' You literally upload all your notes to the app and it gives you different ways to learn: flashcards, quiz, podcast, practice tests, and a voice tutor that explains the material out loud. 'My favourite is the practice tests: I get all the lessons, pick which ones I want, get questions, answer them, and at the end I get my test result.'

Return: 'And we're moving on to the next remark.' Remark 4 (overlay): during class the student threw a firecracker out of the classroom window and put the other students' safety at risk. Joke: 'I'm amazed you even stay in these schools. They'd have kicked me out 3 times already. I talk in class and they want to kick me out.'

Remark 5 (overlay, 'and to finish'): the student got a 1 (fail) and asked if it could be kept spoiler-free for his parents. Joke: it's really not fair, at least wait for the parents' meeting. With e-diaries you used to be able to stay quiet until the meeting. Mum comes home: 'Do I have to blush every time at that parents' meeting?' At least you were alive until the meeting. Now the belt is waiting for you at the door.
Outro CTA: 'And send me your funniest remarks in the comments.'

beats: 1. ASMR cold open: tight close-up of hands squeezing ketchup into a glass of water while the voice tutor explains plainly: 'Even the phone you're holding is made of atoms.'

2. Interruption: the student cuts the tutor off ('Wait, wait, wait… can you explain that to me like some juicy gossip?'). This shows the tutor can be interrupted mid-explanation. The ketchup squeezing continues.

3. Gossip reframe: the tutor replies 'OK, listen to this:'. The nucleus is a mega-popular star that everyone hangs around, and the electrons are fans who keep circling but can never get totally close. Then: 'Crazy, right?'

4. Gossip escalation: the tutor keeps the drama going with questions back to the student: are the electrons loyal fans, borrowing notes, 'a real soap opera, right?', and 'which atoms are the worst in this gossip clan?'. The ASMR prop action stays on screen throughout.
5. Reveal: cut to a close-up of the phone showing Memo AI's voice tutor screen mid-conversation, with the text overlay 'the app is called Memo AI'.
